$comment: Projects that use Hawkes Net (docs/net.md 'Limits and usage'). A project not listed here may still use Hawkes Net with a Gen API key for it: it gets the defaults below. origins: pages that may ask for player tickets with no key (the public door; http://localhost and 127.0.0.1 are always allowed). keyProjects: Gen key project patterns that may make tickets for this project besides keys for the project itself (the portal's key works in usr_* projects). transports: what the project may use. defaults: the room config a ticket starts a room with (a request's config is clamped to it). limits: per project. testPrefix: rooms named so are playtests: free and not counted in totals.

hawkesgenwebsite.name: hawkesgen.com games
hawkesgenwebsite.$comment: No origins: every ticket for the portal's rooms comes from the portal itself (its key), after its own checks (edit tokens, hidden worlds, invitations). An Origin header can be set by anyone outside a browser, so the door would let them into any room here.
